title: hieracium umbrosum subsp. crepidopsis
intro: Hieracium umbrosum subsp. crepidopsis, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, showcasing its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
